system.description:
You’ve learned to squeeze every last bit of charge from your powered weapons and tools.

As an action, you can spend one or more Supply Points to recharge a Powered item or weapon you or an ally you can reach are carrying. It costs 1 Supply Point to recharge a Powered (Breather) item, 2 Supply Points to recharge a Powered (Break) item, and 3 Supply Points to recharge a Powered (Bed) item.
